scope: Complete finite Foley to Magic, controllable ordinary-mode Meta Knight selection and timed 533 to 325 route only.

selection.strategy: Rendered RGB sword-icon patch in the upper-right sector, followed by an ordinary A press.
selection.fixed_recovery: After A: 320 neutral frames, then 120 Up+Left frames with fresh A presses on alternating frames.
selection.tail: Normal flies directly up the clear x 80 to 95 column, then right and down onto the 325 door ledge.

effect.attribution: Actual switch contact pointer resolves to the local player0-parent Meta Knight task.

raw_hash_format: SHA-256 of exact private file bytes; no line-ending normalization.
limitations: The 12 endpoint/control cases cover actual 1 and 6 HP at 100% and 500% enemy health using baseline layout 3. Other ordinary layouts are native-tested only at 100% and 1 HP.
Ordinary layouts 0 to 4 have native completion. Alternate-mode layouts 5 to 7 have source recurrence only, not native cast, recovery or traversal acceptance.
The native fixtures have ability gating and area keys disabled. Host tests enforce the existing safe-to-gate Magic permission but do not establish a separate native permission test.
No other switch, Bomb Block, F1/F6 target, helper route, persistent switch state, renewable source, global Magic grant or general RoomSanity gate is established.
Only frozen v4 inputs and pose are accepted. Earlier failed poses and v1 to v3 tails remain superseded. Waiting variants are separate cold runs, not retries of a finite source.
